card.name: The word dose after a count
card.fires_on: The word "dose" or "doses" right after a number or ordinal such as two, 2, second, fourth or 14. It appears in dosing instructions that count or limit doses.

modes.label: Number then doses
modes.description: A cardinal number directly before "doses" when limiting or counting doses.
modes.example: maximum of three<< doses>> in 24 hours

modes.label: Ordinal then dose
modes.description: An ordinal such as second or fourth before "dose" in dose-reduction steps.

card.writes: The promoted and suppressed tokens are mostly unrelated, so there is no clear output effect.
card.plain: It lights up on the word dose when it follows a count, like "two doses" or "second dose".
